response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong general software development expertise and excellent communication abilities, he critically lacks the mandatory qualifications for this role. He has approximately 6 months of C++ experience compared to the required 5-10 years, no documented Windows platform expertise, and zero capital markets or financial services domain knowledge—all mandatory requirements. The significant gaps in core technical and domain prerequisites make this candidate unsuitable for a mid-senior level capital markets position.
strengths: Extensive full-stack development experience spanning 14+ years across diverse technologies and platforms, demonstrating strong adaptability and learning capability
Proven CI/CD pipeline expertise including GitLab, Docker, Kubernetes, and deployment infrastructure from multiple consulting roles
Excellent communication and teaching abilities evidenced by workshop creation, conference talks, and mentoring—valuable for collaborative capital markets environments
concerns: Only ~6 months of C++ experience at National Instruments (Dec 2014–June 2015), far below the mandatory 5-10 years requirement for this mid-senior position
No documented experience with Windows platform development despite it being explicitly required for this capital markets role
Completely absent capital markets, fixed income, derivatives, or investment banking domain knowledge—disqualifying on the mandatory domain expertise requirement
